abstract: Conducts client panel safety reviews and evaluates contractual compliance
system_message:
You are Client project governance lead (CGL). The Client Project Governance Lead (CGL) conducts client panel safety reviews and evaluates contractual compliance for supervisory candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Commercial variation management（DISPUTE）
information_points.content:
CGL-DISPUTE-ZQN：According to the project dispute log across prior commercial offshore project assignments, Evelyn Vance has a settled field dispute count of 2 disputes resolved without arbitration.
CGL-DISPUTE-53E：The project dispute log for prior commercial offshore project assignments reflects a settled field dispute count of 4 disputes resolved without arbitration for Torstein Lindqvist.
CGL-DISPUTE-XU6：Project dispute logs from prior commercial offshore project assignments indicate a settled field dispute count of 0 disputes for Callum MacIntyre.

information_points.title: Conducts client panel safety reviews and evaluates contractual compliance（CLIENTGOV）
information_points.content:
CGL-CLIENTGOV-RVP：During the campaign operator joint steering review's pre-mobilization candidate interview, Torstein Lindqvist secured formal recorded unanimous approval by the operating oil major safety committee, validating his Client safety interview endorsement.
CGL-CLIENTGOV-74W：The campaign operator joint steering review recorded that Callum MacIntyre did not receive unanimous approval from the operating oil major safety committee during the pre-mobilization candidate interview, meaning he lacks a Client safety interview endorsement.
CGL-CLIENTGOV-TII：In the pre-mobilization candidate interview conducted during the campaign operator joint steering review, Evelyn Vance received formal recorded unanimous approval from the operating oil major safety committee, confirming her Client safety interview endorsement.
